body.statement:
For the input \(\mathcal W_{\mathrm{out}}\), the family \(\mathfrak F_{\mathrm{FD}}(H_{\mathrm{out}},1,\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}},1,2,1)\) is empty, while for every \(M\in\mathfrak M(H_{\mathrm{out}},1,\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}})\),
\[
 P_M(Y_0=1\mid\operatorname{do}(X_{-1}=0))
 =F_{\mathrm{out}}(P_M)
 =\sum_{a\in\{0,1\}}P_M(Y_0=1\mid X_{-1}=0,X_0=a)P_M(X_0=a).
\]
body.proof_tex:
Here \(V=\{X,Y\}\), so the required nonempty mediator set in \(\mathrm{def:micro\text{-}frontdoor\text{-}family}\) cannot exist.  Fix \(M\in\mathfrak M(H_{\mathrm{out}},1,\mathcal A^{\mathrm{bin}})\).  Exact summary says that the only possible observed parents of \(Y_0\) are \(X_{-1}\) and \(X_0\), with at least one of those arguments active, and that \(X_t\) has no observed parent.  There is no bidirected summary edge.  By semi-Markovianity the root of \(Y_0\) is independent of the distinct roots generating \(X_{-1}\) and \(X_0\), and those latter roots are independent of one another.  Define
\[
 g(u,v)=P_M\{f_Y(u,v,U_{Y,0})=1\},
\]
omitting an argument if its lag is absent.  Exogenous independence and cylinder positivity imply
\[
 P_M(Y_0=1\mid X_{-1}=u,X_0=v)=g(u,v).
\]
Under \(\operatorname{do}(X_{-1}=0)\), the variable \(X_0\) and root \(U_{Y,0}\) retain their observational laws.  The truncated structural equations and the law of total probability give
\[
 \begin{aligned}
 P_M(Y_0=1\mid\operatorname{do}(X_{-1}=0))
 &=\sum_{a\in\{0,1\}}g(0,a)P_M(X_0=a)\\
 &=\sum_{a\in\{0,1\}}P_M(Y_0=1\mid X_{-1}=0,X_0=a)P_M(X_0=a)\\
 &=F_{\mathrm{out}}(P_M).
 \end{aligned}
\]
Every displayed conditional has positive denominator by cylinder positivity.
